title: TS inc's Small Sword
description: Every Sword in the game now small.
body:
Short Swords Resource Pack

This simple resource pack makes every single sword in the game smaller.

Features:

    Shrinks wooden, stone, iron, golden, diamond, and netherite swords.

    Perfect for PvP and Bedwars (gives you a much better field of view).

    Clean and vanilla-friendly design.
